title: ArEssays: Towards Robust Arabic Handwritten Text Understanding in Educational Settings
abstract: arXiv:2611.32211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated understanding of handwritten Arabic student essays remains challenging due to script complexity and high variability   in children's writing. We introduce ArEssays, a large-scale dataset of authentic essays from primary to secondary students   across Egypt, with both verbatim transcriptions and linguistically corrected versions. We benchmark 34 vision-language and OCR   models, including fine-tuned systems, and find large performance gaps on real student handwriting. We release the dataset,   training pipelines, and results to support research in Arabic OCR, document understanding, and educational NLP.

translated_title: ArEssays：迈向教育场景下鲁棒的阿拉伯语手写文本理解
translated_abstract: 由于阿拉伯语文字的复杂性以及儿童书写的高度可变性，对手写阿拉伯语学生作文的自动理解仍然是一项挑战。我们提出了ArEssays，这是一个大规模数据集，包含来自埃及小学至中学学生的真实作文，并同时提供逐字转录版本和语言修正版本。我们对34个视觉-语言模型和OCR模型（包括经过微调的系统）进行了基准测试，发现现有模型在真实学生手写内容上存在较大的性能差距。我们发布了该数据集、训练流程和测试结果，以支持阿拉伯语OCR、文档理解和教育NLP领域的研究。
tldr: 提出大规模阿拉伯语学生手写作文数据集ArEssays，通过对34个视觉-语言和OCR模型的基准测试，揭示了现有模型在真实儿童手写内容上的显著性能差距。
en_tdlr: We introduce ArEssays, a large-scale dataset of authentic handwritten Arabic student essays, and benchmark 34 vision-language and OCR models, revealing large performance gaps on real children's handwriting.
